description: A store employs senior citizens who earn $500 per week and young adults who earn $750 per week. The store must keep the weekly wage bill below $30000. On any day, the store requires at least 50 workers, of whom at least 10 must be young adults. To ensure the store runs smoothly, the number of young adults should be at least a third the number of senior citizens. Formulate a LP to minimize the wage bill.

SeniorWage.definition: Weekly wage rate for senior citizens

YoungAdultWage.definition: Weekly wage rate for young adults

MinWorkersPerDay.definition: Minimum number of workers required per day

MinYoungAdultsPerDay.definition: Minimum number of young adults required per day

MinYoungToSeniorRatio.definition: Minimum ratio of young adults to senior citizens

objective.description: "Minimize the total weekly wage bill for senior citizens and young adult employees"

constraints.description: 500 * (Number of senior citizens) + 750 * (Number of young adults) <= 30000
Number of senior citizens + Number of young adults >= 50
Number of young adults >= (1/3) * (Number of senior citizens)
